agreement.measure: Cohen's kappa over the (page, span_start, span_end) units two annotators both labelled, on the label field; units labelled by only one annotator are counted as single-annotated, never silently dropped
agreement.register: evaluation/annotation-agreement.jsonl (append-only, seeded header-only; records are created ONLY when the owner performs labelling)

hard_boundary: The LABELLING itself is the owner's and is NOT performed by this machinery. No labels are created by any command here; this module validates record shapes and computes agreement over records a human supplies.

fields.annotator: who supplied this annotation record (a human, or 'recommender' for a suggestion)
fields.kb_target: wikilink target of the knowledge-base page the mention links to, or null with kb_unlinked_reason
fields.label: the label applied or suggested
fields.page: wiki page (repo-relative path) the mention occurs on
fields.span_end: end character offset in the page body
fields.span_start: start character offset in the page body

pattern: INCEpTION pattern only (deep-study batch 8, UKP Lab TU Darmstadt): recommender-suggests / human-accepts, agreement-measured double annotation on golden-set pages, KB-linked mentions. INCEpTION itself is NOT deployed.

rules: a record starts as 'suggested' when its annotator is a recommender, or directly as 'accepted' when a human records their own annotation
only a human may move a suggestion to 'accepted' or 'rejected'; this machinery never transitions state - it validates the state a record declares
a rejected suggestion is kept as a record, never deleted
